articles.title: ON Semiconductor Falls 5%, NXP Semiconductors Drops 4% as Soft Guidance Revives Auto Chip Worries; Skyworks Ticks Up, Qualcomm and Texas Instruments Dip
articles.description: NXP Semiconductors beat earnings estimates but its cautious outlook sent auto-exposed chipmakers sliding, and the ripple effect is hitting ON Semiconductor harder than NXP itself. Whether that selloff signals a broader auto chip downturn or a buying opportunity depends on what ON Semiconductor's next report reveals.

articles.title: Anduril, Qualcomm partner on BlueChip computer hardware line
articles.description: The semiconductor company will supply its Snapdragon X Series processor to power the defense startup’s laptop, which will be built at its Arsenal-1 facility in Ohio. TSMC will manufacture the Snapdragon chip.

articles.title: What Is Qualcomm (QCOM) Signaling With Its BlueChip Government Laptop Push?
articles.description: QUALCOMM (NasdaqGS:QCOM) and defense technology contractor Anduril are launching a US-focused BlueChip laptop for government and first responders in 2026. The BlueChip device is positioned as a secure, US-assembled system with a supply chain centered on domestic components and manufacturing partners.
